Face, Breast, Body & Reconstruction

Cosmetic Surgery in Bangalore

Cosmetic and reconstructive surgery in Whitefield, Bangalore, planned around your anatomy, safety and recovery. Every plan starts with a consultation and examination, and surgery is only discussed once it suits you.

Call the Clinic

Surgery Planned Around Anatomy, Safety and Recovery

Cosmetic surgery changes the shape or proportion of the face, breasts or body because you want it to. Reconstructive surgery restores form or function after injury, burns, illness or earlier surgery. Both start the same way at NeoSculpt6: a doctor-led consultation and examination before any procedure is planned.

Suitability, the technique, scars and recovery differ from person to person. Your consultation explains the options, their limits and risks, and what recovery involves, so you can decide with clear information.

  • 01

    Doctor-led assessment

    Your concern, health and anatomy are examined by the surgeon who plans your care.

  • 02

    Face and facial profile

    Nose, eyelids, chin, jawline and facial ageing, planned for balance rather than a template.

  • 03

    Breast and body

    Breast, abdomen and body-contour surgery, with scars and recovery explained before you decide.

  • 04

    Reconstruction and repair

    Trauma, burns, scars and earlier surgery, where function and comfort may matter as much as appearance.

  • 05

    Suitability first

    Where surgery is not the right step, or not yet, you are told why and what else may help.

Cosmetic & Reconstructive Surgery

Explore each procedure, or book a consultation and let the examination point you to the right one.

Face & Facial Profile

Procedures for the nose, eyelids, chin, cheeks, ears and facial ageing.

  • Rhinoplasty

    Rhinoplasty reshapes the nose by changing selected bone, cartilage or soft-tissue structures, for cosmetic refinement, breathing-related correction or both.

    Explore: Rhinoplasty

  • Facelift Surgery

    Facelift surgery addresses lower-face and jawline ageing caused by tissue descent, jowling and laxity, with neck tightening included when anatomy requires it.

    Explore: Facelift Surgery

  • Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery)

    Blepharoplasty is eyelid surgery that removes or repositions selected excess skin and fat around the upper or lower lids.

    Explore: Blepharoplasty (Eyelid Surgery)

  • Chin Augmentation Surgery

    Chin augmentation is surgery that increases the projection, length or shape of a small or recessed chin.

    Explore: Chin Augmentation Surgery

  • Dimple Creation Surgery

    Dimple creation, or dimpleplasty, is a minor surgical procedure designed to create a small indentation in the cheek that becomes more visible during smiling.

    Explore: Dimple Creation Surgery

  • Ear Lobe Repair Surgery

    Earlobes can split after an earring tear, gradually elongate from heavy jewellery or stretch after large-gauge piercings.

    Explore: Ear Lobe Repair Surgery

  • Xanthelasma Removal Treatment

    Xanthelasma causes soft yellow plaques, usually near the inner eyelid corners. They are benign but may be removed for appearance or if they grow.

    Explore: Xanthelasma Removal Treatment

Breast

Breast size, shape and position, and male chest concerns.

  • Breast Augmentation Surgery

    Breast augmentation adds volume using implants and, in selected cases, fat transfer. It can restore lost volume, improve proportion, address asymmetry or create a fuller shape.

    Explore: Breast Augmentation Surgery

  • Breast Lift Surgery (Mastopexy)

    Breast lift surgery, also called mastopexy, is a cosmetic procedure that improves breast position, firmness and shape without substantially changing breast size.

    Explore: Breast Lift Surgery (Mastopexy)

  • Breast Reduction Surgery

    Breast reduction removes selected breast tissue, fat and skin to reduce breast weight and reshape the breast.

    Explore: Breast Reduction Surgery

  • Gynecomastia Surgery

    Gynecomastia is enlargement of male breast tissue from glandular tissue, fat or both, and the treatment plan depends on what is creating the chest fullness.

    Explore: Gynecomastia Surgery

Body Contouring Surgery

Surgery for localised fat, loose abdominal skin and changes after pregnancy.

  • Liposuction Surgery

    Liposuction removes chosen pockets of subcutaneous fat through small cannulas to refine body shape.

    Explore: Liposuction Surgery

  • Tummy Tuck Surgery (Abdominoplasty)

    An abdominoplasty removes selected excess abdominal skin and fat and can tighten lax or separated muscles when needed.

    Explore: Tummy Tuck Surgery (Abdominoplasty)

  • Mommy Makeover Surgery

    "Mommy makeover" is a planning term for selected cosmetic surgeries that address changes after pregnancy, breastfeeding and weight fluctuation.

    Explore: Mommy Makeover Surgery

Reconstructive, Trauma, Scar & Burn Repair

Restoring form and function after injury, burns, illness or earlier surgery.

  • Advanced Trauma Reconstruction

    Injuries from accidents, sports, workplace incidents, animal bites or complex facial trauma can change appearance, function, mobility and quality of life.

    Explore: Advanced Trauma Reconstruction

  • Burn Scar Reconstruction Surgery

    Burn injuries can cause long-term physical and emotional effects, such as scarring, restricted movement, skin tightness, contractures and changes in appearance.

    Explore: Burn Scar Reconstruction Surgery

  • Head & Neck Reconstruction Surgery

    Trauma, cancer surgery, congenital conditions, infection or tissue loss can affect head and neck appearance, speech, swallowing, breathing and quality of life.

    Explore: Head & Neck Reconstruction Surgery

  • Scar Revision Surgery

    NeoSculpt6 offers tailored scar revision in Bangalore for scars from surgery, burns, injuries, acne or trauma.

    Explore: Scar Revision Surgery

  • Post-Surgical Correction Surgery

    NeoSculpt6 offers post-surgical correction in Bangalore for patients seeking improvement after an earlier cosmetic, reconstructive or surgical procedure.

    Explore: Post-Surgical Correction Surgery

Vitiligo Surgery & Pigment Care

Surgical and light-based options for stable vitiligo, after a dermatology assessment.

  • Melanocyte Transfer Surgery

    NeoSculpt6 offers melanocyte transfer surgery for patients with stable vitiligo who want long-term pigment restoration.

    Explore: Melanocyte Transfer Surgery

  • NCECS Treatment

    NeoSculpt6 considers NCECS for selected patients with stable vitiligo who may benefit from surgical pigment restoration.

    Explore: NCECS Treatment

  • Phototherapy for Vitiligo

    NeoSculpt6 offers personalised, light-based phototherapy for vitiligo, designed to stimulate repigmentation and help manage pigment loss.

    Explore: Phototherapy for Vitiligo

  • Vitiligo Treatment

    NeoSculpt6 offers personalised vitiligo care in Bangalore for pigment loss and white patches, with dermatologist-led plans based on the type, severity and progression of the condition, using medical and surgical approaches aimed at pigment restoration and long-term skin health.

    Explore: Vitiligo Treatment

Your Surgical Journey

From Consultation to Follow-Up

Your concern, health, medicines and previous procedures, and an examination of the area.

Whether surgery suits you now, and the alternatives, including not operating.

The technique, likely scar placement, anaesthesia and the recovery your plan involves.

Risks, limits and aftercare explained in writing, with time for your questions before you decide.

Aftercare guidance for wound care, activity and return to work, matched to your procedure.

Review appointments while you heal; results settle over time and vary from person to person.

    Quick Answers

    Cosmetic Surgery FAQs

    Cosmetic surgery changes appearance by choice, such as the shape of the nose or breasts. Reconstructive surgery restores form or function after injury, burns, illness or earlier surgery. Your consultation clarifies which applies to your concern.

    Suitability depends on your health, anatomy, goals and how stable your weight or condition is. The surgeon examines you and explains whether surgery suits you, and what the alternatives are.

    Most surgery leaves a scar. Where it sits, how it is planned and how it matures are discussed at your consultation, along with aftercare that supports healing.

    Recovery depends on the procedure, the extent of surgery and your health. Your plan sets out time off work, activity limits and follow-up before you decide.

    Some can. Correction depends on the tissue, the scar and what went wrong, so it starts with a detailed examination.

    Cost depends on your assessment, the procedure, technique and anaesthesia, any hospital stay and follow-up, so it is explained after your consultation rather than quoted in advance.
